about: Experience v3 as data (docs/specs/experience-v3.md, 2026-11-16). A proposal: governance/design.json stays the live source that tests read until each group below is adopted by a fix in docs/specs/experience-fixes.md. v3 keeps every colour pair that design.json already measures and adds what v2 lacked: natural materials with one meaning each, light by time of day, spring motion, sound (off by default), attention budgets, the behaviour rules and the floors a test can hold.
adoption: One group at a time, by a brief in docs/specs/experience-fixes.md. A group is live when a test reads it from this file; until then it is a target, not a claim.

colour.about: Neutrals unchanged from design.json (obsidian and ivory, AA in both themes). The four state colours below are new text-safe tokens: each is at least 6:1 on --bg, --card and --raise in its theme (measured 2026-11-16; the adopting test must measure again).

meaning.--leaf: the one primary action or mark on a screen; never text on a light surface
meaning.--dawn: today, a beginning, the next small step
meaning.--rest: paused, rested, snoozed: a chosen stop, never a failure
meaning.--amber: late or needs attention: one action offered
meaning.--red: real danger only: a scam, data loss, a security block. Never a missed habit, a late step or a low score
meaning.--focus: the keyboard focus ring and a running focus timer

never: #000000 as a page background
red for a missed day or a late item
colour as the only carrier of a state: every state has a word or a shape too
more than one gold element in view

materials.about: Each material is taken from nature (governance/nature-atlas.json) and has ONE meaning. One natural element per surface. Every material has a flat fallback that carries the same meaning without the GPU, under forced colours and under reduced transparency.

gold-leaf.from: polished gold: bright top, warm core, dark foot

jade.from: polished nephrite, light held under the surface

moonstone.from: adularescence: a soft blue-white sheen that moves with the light

kintsugi.means: a miss you came back from
kintsugi.from: a gold seam through a mended bowl
kintsugi.fallback: a ring with one --leaf line across it and the word 'mended'

ruby.from: a cut ruby, table highlight from above

light.about: One light source, from above, the same on every surface. In dark the screen is a cabin at night: light comes from the controls, not the page. The time of day changes one accent line only, never contrast or layout.

night.rule: after 22:00 nothing new is asked; the screen offers the floor and rest

motion.about: Motion confirms a change the person made, then settles. Nothing moves by itself for more than a moment; decoration rests when the person does.

spring.about: for a tick, a ring closing, a sheet arriving

paused_when: battery saver where it can be read

never: motion that loops while the person reads
parallax on scroll
a flash more than three times a second
motion as the only signal of a change
motion.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion or the still switch: no ambient motion, changes cross-fade in 150 ms or cut

sound.about: Off by default, for everyone, always. A rail only: no sound ships until the person turns it on in Settings. When on: at most one soft, short tone for a kept day; never for a miss, a reminder or an error.

events: the third tick of the day
when_on.source: generated in the browser (no audio file to fetch)

never: on first run
autoplay
for a miss, a reminder, an error or a streak at risk
speech unless the person taps Listen

haptics.about: One gate for every vibration: the haptics switch, reduced motion and the still switch all silence it.
never: every tap
scrolling
typing
a reminder
a call that bypasses the gate
text under 12 px
capitals for more than three words
an exclamation mark
justified text

space.ratio_use: hero proportions and the size step between a title and its body

targets.inline_term: an invisible 44 px hit area that does not move the line
targets.main_action: always on screen without scrolling at 320 x 568 and up

attention.about: The budget a screen may spend before the person acts. Built for a tired, distracted or ADHD mind; it serves everyone.
attention.interruptions: none while a focus timer runs or a field has focus

behaviour.about: The rules that keep nudges honest. Each one is a test, not a tone.
defaults: the safe, small choice is pre-selected
every default can be changed in one tap and says so
nothing is switched on that costs money, shares data or sends a message

streak.measure: habit strength (a weighted average over about 20 days), shown as kept days; never a counter that resets to zero
streak.miss: one miss changes nothing visible but an empty ring; two in a row offers the two-minute floor
streak.return: a miss you came back from is mended in gold (kintsugi) and stays in the story
streak.rest: a rest day is chosen in one tap, drawn as still water, and never counts as a miss

allowed_when: the loss is real and already happening
the number comes from the person's own data, never from example data
it is said once per cause, with the one step that stops it
the person can dismiss it for at least 30 days
examples_allowed: Twelve days of changes live only on this phone. Save a copy.
A late fee was charged last month. Set autopay for the total due.
never: a countdown that is not a real deadline
a loss invented to drive a visit
a loss shown from example numbers
shame for something the person did not do

dark_patterns_never: a pre-ticked box that shares or spends
nagging after a no (ask again only after 30 days)
making leaving, exporting or erasing harder than joining
a reward that is random on purpose

notifications.wording: an invitation and one action; never a count of misses

feedback.about: Every action answers in under 100 ms, in three channels at most: sight, a polite announcement, and (if on) one haptic.
feedback.announce: one polite live region for the whole app; a tick says the item and the count ('Move done. 1 of 3.')
feedback.focus: stays on the thing the person just used after any redraw
feedback.errors: what happened, why, the one next step; in the page, never a browser alert
feedback.undo: offered for 30 minutes on anything that changes data; irreversible actions need a typed word and offer the safe step first

structure: every dialog has a name, takes focus, closes on Escape and gives focus back
accessibility.names: every control and field has an accessible name; every click target is a button or a link
accessibility.zoom: text to 200% and reflow at 320 px with no loss and no sideways scroll

performance.ambient_cpu: none while idle 20 s or hidden

measured_2026_11_16.about: The Life OS at 390 x 844, dark, a real browser. The baseline the fixes are ranked against. Re-measure before closing the queue item.
